name: Verdura Golf & Spa Resort
positioning: Rocco Forte's Verdura Resort, a golf and spa resort on the southwest coast of Sicily with Kyle Phillips links courses along the Mediterranean
best_for: Golfers who want links courses on the Sicilian coast
Couples and families wanting sea-view rooms with private terraces and a large spa

facts.text: The resort is on the southwest coast of Sicily.
The links-style courses span 230 hectares of Sicilian coastline with views of the Mediterranean Sea.
Golf is played on two championship courses and a nine-hole Executive Course.
Verdura East Links, a Kyle Phillips design, is defined by narrow fairways.
The Clubhouse terrace overlooks the Verdura West Shore course.
Liola is the resort's trattoria and pizzeria serving Sicilian dishes.
Amare is the beachside restaurant, serving freshly caught fish.
Fulvio Pierangelini is creative director of food.
Solar panels help produce the spa's hot water.
The kids club has a heated swimming pool.
Guests can dive with certified instructors, ride horses, and play tennis or padel.

highlights.text: The golf Clubhouse is set beside the Torre, a 16th-century watchtower.
The Verdura West Shore course finishes on the shoreline of the Mediterranean Sea.
The resort has 45 holes of golf designed by Kyle Phillips.
The 4,000-square-meter spa is surrounded by olive and orange groves and was brought to life by Irene Forte.
Every room has a sea view and a private terrace.

considerations.text: The airport transfer is a 90-minute drive.
The nearest town, the historic fishing port of Sciacca, is a 15-minute drive from the resort.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the high-end positioning.
